(#{t.marketingTaskId}, #{t.accountId}, #{t.accountPhone}, #{t.targetScope}, #{t.groupLinkId}, #{t.groupJid}, #{t.groupLinkUrl}, #{t.groupName}, #{t.status}, #{t.sentMessageCount}, #{t.failedMessageCount}, #{t.retryCount}, #{t.lastAttemptAt}, #{t.lastSentAt}, #{t.lastReason}, #{t.createdAt}, #{t.updatedAt})

INSERT INTO marketing_task_target (marketing_task_id, account_id, account_phone, target_scope, group_link_id, group_jid, group_link_url, group_name, status, sent_message_count, failed_message_count, retry_count, last_attempt_at, last_sent_at, last_reason, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{marketingTaskId}, #{accountId}, #{accountPhone}, #{targetScope}, #{groupLinkId}, #{groupJid}, #{groupLinkUrl}, #{groupName}, #{status}, #{sentMessageCount}, #{failedMessageCount}, #{retryCount}, #{lastAttemptAt}, #{lastSentAt}, #{lastReason}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM marketing_task WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM marketing_task_target t LEFT JOIN account a ON a.id = t.account_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE t.marketing_task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY t.id ASC

WITH attempt_facts AS ( SELECT t.account_id AS accountId, t.account_phone AS accountPhone, t.id AS targetId, a.id AS attemptId, a.status AS attemptStatus, a.reason_code AS reasonCode, a.reason_message AS reasonMessage, a.group_status AS rawGroupStatus, a.group_status_reason AS groupStatusReason, a.round_no AS roundNo, a.attempt_no AS attemptNo, COALESCE(a.result_at, a.attempted_at, a.created_at) AS eventAt, COALESCE(a.group_link_id, p.group_link_id, t.group_link_id) AS groupLinkId, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(p.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.group_jid), '') ) AS groupJid, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(p.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.group_jid), ''), CONCAT('link:', COALESCE(a.group_link_id, p.group_link_id, t.group_link_id)), CONCAT('target:', t.id) ) AS groupKey, COALESCE(g.link_url, t.group_link_url) AS groupLinkUrl, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(g.group_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(p.wa_subject), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.group_name), '') ) AS groupName FROM marketing_task_target t JOIN marketing_task_send_attempt a ON a.target_id = t.id AND a.marketing_task_id = t.marketing_task_id LEFT JOIN group_link_preview p ON p.group_link_id = COALESCE(a.group_link_id, t.group_link_id) LEFT JOIN group_link g ON g.id = COALESCE(a.group_link_id, p.group_link_id, t.group_link_id) WHERE t.marketing_task_id = #{taskId} AND a.marketing_task_id = #{taskId} AND a.status IN (0, 1, 2, 3) ), group_aggregate AS ( SELECT accountId, accountPhone, groupKey, MAX(groupLinkId) AS groupLinkId, MAX(groupJid) AS groupJid, SUBSTRING_INDEX( GROUP_CONCAT( groupLinkUrl ORDER BY eventAt DESC, attemptId DESC SEPARATOR '
' ), '
', 1 ) AS groupLinkUrl, SUBSTRING_INDEX( GROUP_CONCAT( groupName ORDER BY eventAt DESC, attemptId DESC SEPARATOR '
' ), '
', 1 ) AS groupName, SUM(CASE WHEN attemptStatus = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sentMessageCount, SUM(CASE WHEN attemptStatus = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedMessageCount, MAX(eventAt) AS lastAttemptAt, MAX(CASE WHEN attemptStatus = 1 THEN eventAt ELSE NULL END) AS lastSentAt, NULLIF( SUBSTRING_INDEX( GROUP_CONCAT( CASE WHEN attemptStatus IN (2, 3) THEN COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(reasonMessage), ''), reasonCode, CASE WHEN attemptStatus = 3 THEN '本轮已跳过' ELSE '发送失败' END ) WHEN attemptStatus = 1 THEN '' ELSE NULL END ORDER BY eventAt DESC, attemptId DESC SEPARATOR '
' ), '
', 1 ), '' ) AS lastReason FROM attempt_facts GROUP BY accountId, accountPhone, groupKey ), latest_effective AS ( SELECT ranked.* FROM ( SELECT effective.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY accountId, groupKey ORDER BY roundNo DESC, attemptNo DESC, attemptId DESC ) AS effectiveRank FROM attempt_facts effective WHERE attemptStatus IN (1, 2) ) ranked WHERE ranked.effectiveRank = 1 ) SELECT g.accountId, g.accountPhone, g.groupLinkId, g.groupJid, g.groupLinkUrl, g.groupName, e.attemptStatus AS latestAttemptStatus, e.reasonCode AS reasonCode, e.reasonMessage AS reasonMessage, e.rawGroupStatus AS groupStatus, e.groupStatusReason AS groupStatusReason, g.sentMessageCount, g.failedMessageCount, g.lastAttemptAt, g.lastSentAt, g.lastReason FROM group_aggregate g LEFT JOIN latest_effective e ON e.accountId = g.accountId AND e.groupKey = g.groupKey ORDER BY g.accountId ASC, g.lastAttemptAt DESC, g.groupKey ASC

mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO marketing_task_success_group (marketing_task_id, group_jid, first_success_attempt_id, first_success_at, created_at, tenant_id) SELECT a.marketing_task_id, TRIM(a.group_jid), a.id, COALESCE(a.result_at, #{now}), #{now}, a.tenant_id FROM marketing_task_send_attempt a WHERE a.id = #{attemptId} AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.marketing_task_id = #{taskId} AND a.status = 1 AND a.group_jid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.group_jid) <> '' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM group_creation_marketing_item item WHERE item.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND item.marketing_attempt_id = a.id )
mapper.update: UPDATE marketing_task SET sent_message_count = sent_message_count + #{successDelta}, failed_message_count = failed_message_count + #{failedDelta}, last_sent_at = CASE WHEN #{successDelta} > 0 THEN #{now} ELSE last_sent_at END, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{taskId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE marketing_task_target t JOIN marketing_task_send_attempt a ON a.id = #{attemptId} AND a.target_id = t.id LEFT JOIN group_link_preview p ON p.group_jid = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.group_jid), '')) LEFT JOIN group_link g ON g.id = COALESCE(a.group_link_id, p.group_link_id, t.group_link_id) SET t.group_link_id = COALESCE(a.group_link_id, p.group_link_id, t.group_link_id), t.group_jid = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(p.group_jid), ''), t.group_jid), t.group_link_url = COALESCE(g.link_url, t.group_link_url), t.group_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(g.group_name), ''), p.wa_subject, t.group_name), t.status = CASE WHEN t.failed_message_count > 0 THEN 5 ELSE 3 END, t.sent_message_count = t.sent_message_count + 1, t.last_attempt_at = #{resultAt}, t.last_sent_at = #{resultAt}, t.last_reason = CASE WHEN t.failed_message_count > 0 THEN t.last_reason ELSE NULL END, t.updated_at = #{resultAt} WHERE t.id = #{targetId}

UPDATE marketing_task_target t JOIN marketing_task_send_attempt a ON a.id = #{attemptId} AND a.target_id = t.id LEFT JOIN group_link_preview p ON p.group_jid = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.group_jid), '')) LEFT JOIN group_link g ON g.id = COALESCE(a.group_link_id, p.group_link_id, t.group_link_id) SET t.group_link_id = COALESCE(a.group_link_id, p.group_link_id, t.group_link_id), t.group_jid = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(p.group_jid), ''), t.group_jid), t.group_link_url = COALESCE(g.link_url, t.group_link_url), t.group_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(g.group_name), ''), p.wa_subject, t.group_name), t.status = CASE WHEN t.sent_message_count > 0 THEN 5 ELSE 4 END, t.failed_message_count = t.failed_message_count + 1, t.last_attempt_at = #{resultAt}, t.last_reason = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{reasonMessage}), ''), #{reasonCode}, '发送失败'), t.updated_at = #{resultAt} WHERE t.id = #{targetId}

SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.ws_phone AS accountPhone, m.group_link_id AS groupLinkId, m.group_jid AS groupJid, g.link_url AS groupLinkUrl, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(g.group_name), ''), p.wa_subject) AS groupName FROM account a JOIN account_group_membership m ON m.account_id = a.id LEFT JOIN group_link g ON g.id = m.group_link_id LEFT JOIN group_link_preview p ON p.group_link_id = g.id AND p.group_jid = m.group_jid WHERE a.id = #{accountId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.protocol_account_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.protocol_account_id) <> '' AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND (#{accountGroupSendAt} IS NULL OR m.joined_at >= #{accountGroupSendAt}) AND m.group_jid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(m.group_jid) <> '' ORDER BY m.group_link_id ASC

SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.ws_phone AS accountPhone, m.group_link_id AS groupLinkId, m.group_jid AS groupJid, g.link_url AS groupLinkUrl, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(g.group_name), ''), p.wa_subject) AS groupName FROM account a JOIN account_state s ON s.account_id = a.id JOIN account_group_membership m ON m.account_id = a.id AND m.group_link_id = #{groupLinkId} JOIN group_link g ON g.id = m.group_link_id AND g.deleted_at IS NULL AND g.membership_state IN (2, 3) LEFT JOIN group_link_preview p ON p.group_link_id = g.id AND p.group_jid = m.group_jid LEFT JOIN group_link_health h ON h.group_link_id = g.id LEFT JOIN account_group_baseline b ON b.account_id = a.id AND a.group_baseline_state = 2 WHERE a.id = #{accountId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.login_state = 1 AND s.account_state = 2 AND a.protocol_account_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.protocol_account_id) <> '' AND a.group_baseline_state IN (2, 3) AND (s.risk_status IS NULL OR s.risk_status = 1) AND s.mute_status IS NULL AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.group_jid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(m.group_jid) <> '' AND (h.id IS NULL OR (COALESCE(h.is_banned, 0) = 0 AND (h.health_status IS NULL OR h.health_status = 1))) AND ( a.group_baseline_state <> 2 OR b.id IS NULL OR COALESCE(JSON_CONTAINS(b.baseline_group_jids, JSON_QUOTE(m.group_jid)), 0) = 0 ) LIMIT 1

SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.ws_phone AS wsPhone, a.protocol_account_id AS protocolAccountId, a.group_baseline_state AS groupBaselineState, b.baseline_group_jids AS baselineGroupJidsJson, s.account_state AS accountState, s.login_state AS loginState, s.risk_status AS riskStatus, s.mute_status AS muteStatus, COALESCE(gm.groupCount, 0) AS groupCount FROM account a LEFT JOIN account_state s ON s.account_id = a.id LEFT JOIN account_group_baseline b ON b.account_id = a.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT m.account_id, COUNT(*) AS groupCount FROM account_group_membership m JOIN account aa ON aa.id = m.account_id AND aa.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN group_link g ON g.id = m.group_link_id AND g.deleted_at IS NULL AND g.membership_state IN (2, 3) LEFT JOIN group_link_health h ON h.group_link_id = g.id LEFT JOIN account_group_baseline b ON b.account_id = aa.id AND aa.group_baseline_state = 2 WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.group_jid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(m.group_jid) <> '' AND (h.id IS NULL OR (COALESCE(h.is_banned, 0) = 0 AND (h.health_status IS NULL OR h.health_status = 1))) AND ( aa.group_baseline_state <> 2 OR b.id IS NULL OR COALESCE(JSON_CONTAINS(b.baseline_group_jids, JSON_QUOTE(m.group_jid)), 0) = 0 ) GROUP BY m.account_id ) gm ON gm.account_id = a.id WHERE a.account_group_id = #{groupId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.login_state = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, a.id ASC

SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.ws_phone AS wsPhone, a.protocol_account_id AS protocolAccountId, a.group_baseline_state AS groupBaselineState, b.baseline_group_jids AS baselineGroupJidsJson, s.account_state AS accountState, s.login_state AS loginState, s.risk_status AS riskStatus, s.mute_status AS muteStatus, COALESCE(gm.groupCount, 0) AS groupCount FROM account a LEFT JOIN account_state s ON s.account_id = a.id LEFT JOIN account_group_baseline b ON b.account_id = a.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT m.account_id, COUNT(*) AS groupCount FROM account_group_membership m JOIN account aa ON aa.id = m.account_id AND aa.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN group_link g ON g.id = m.group_link_id AND g.deleted_at IS NULL AND g.membership_state IN (2, 3) LEFT JOIN group_link_health h ON h.group_link_id = g.id LEFT JOIN account_group_baseline b ON b.account_id = aa.id AND aa.group_baseline_state = 2 WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.group_jid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(m.group_jid) <> '' AND (h.id IS NULL OR (COALESCE(h.is_banned, 0) = 0 AND (h.health_status IS NULL OR h.health_status = 1))) AND ( aa.group_baseline_state <> 2 OR b.id IS NULL OR COALESCE(JSON_CONTAINS(b.baseline_group_jids, JSON_QUOTE(m.group_jid)), 0) = 0 ) GROUP BY m.account_id ) gm ON gm.account_id = a.id WHERE a.id = #{accountId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
